name: Fatema Mernissi
shortBio: Moroccan Islamic feminist sociologist and historian whose historical-critical methodology excavated early Islamic egalitarian memory while deconstructing spatial segregation (hudud) and patriarchal hadith transmission.
centralQuestion: Is gender hierarchy intrinsic to foundational Islamic scripture, or is it a later historical fabrication of patriarchal political elites?

keyWorks.title: Beyond the Veil: Male-Female Dynamics in Modern Muslim Society
keyWorks.description: Landmark sociological study of gender space, sexuality, and modernization in postcolonial North Africa.

keyWorks.title: The Veil and the Male Elite: A Feminist Interpretation of Women's Rights in Islam
keyWorks.description: Rigorous historical-philological critique of misogynistic hadith isnads, reclaiming Medina's egalitarian political memory.
